descriptions.notStarted: #p1002001# asked you to investigate the wooden box that #p20000# always carries around.
descriptions.inProgress: You find unidentified medication inside the box.
descriptions.completed: It turned out that #p20000# had been taking his own special arthritis medicine behind #p1002001#'s back. You made a deal with him, promising not to tell anyone about the contents of his wooden box in exchange for a small reward. You shouldn't tell #p1002001# about the wooden box. Just make something up.
